maya: Quick sync — we need to triage customer asks vs. core MVP for the Optimize toolkit. Focus areas: batching recommendations, prefix/KV caching presets, quantization suggestion pipeline, and eval-triggered alerts. Can we list minimal launch criteria and what to push to v2?

sameer: +1. From infra side, top constraints are latency SLOs and memory for KV cache. For MVP we should ship: offline recommender + simple runtime hints (batch_size, max_seq, preferred_quant). Not the auto-applier yet.

kai: For quant recommendations, we can provide a per-model profile: accuracy delta (delta_ROUGE / delta_EMB) vs latency/cost. Prototype script: 
```
# profile_model.py (very rough)
profile(model, dataset):
  run_fp16()
  run_int8()
  compute_quality_delta()
  emit_csv()
```
Will take ~1–2 days per model to run on our infra.

julia: Customer asks: fintech wants deterministic latency + recommended caching layers for chat sessions; marketplace customer wants guidance on bursty traffic (batching knobs). Both asked for an alert when quality drops >3% on golden prompts. That sounds like eval-triggered alerts.

maya: Proposed MVP scope (strict):
- Recs engine (read-only) that returns JSON with: `batch_size`, `batch_timeout_ms`, `cache_ttl_profile`, `quant_recommendation`, `expected_latency_ms`, `expected_cost_pct`.
- Webhook/console view for top-10 recommendations per model.
- Eval-triggered alert: threshold-based (users provide prompt set), no automatic remediation.
- Canary rollout support via flagging (console + API).
Anything beyond that (auto-apply quant, live cache replication, multi-tenant autoscale) -> v2.

sameer: Ops notes: we need tracing and token-level cost estimate in output for each rec. Also recommend `batch_timeout_ms` default to 50ms for low-latency customers, 200ms for high-throughput. We'll add `recommended_mode: \"latency\" | \"throughput\"`.

kai: On evaluation alerts — we should tie to our eval infra and allow both absolute and relative thresholds. Implementation idea: store baseline metrics per-model+version, then run daily evals on customer prompt sets (opt-in). If drop > threshold, notify and include failing examples. Privacy: customer prompts must be hashed & stored encrypted.

julia: Launch criteria proposal:
- Accuracy/regression false-positive rate < 5% on internal evals
- 3 customer pilots (including one fintech + one marketplace) with sign-off
- End-to-end latency for rec call < 120ms 95th under test traffic
- UX: console surface + API + webhook working w/ docs
- SRE: runbook + rollback flag
- Legal/compliance sign-off for storing hashed prompts

maya: Budget and prioritization ask: we have ~3 sprints to get MVP ready for pilot. Priorities: rec engine > eval-alert plumbing > UI. If we need to cut, drop console polish and just expose API + webhook.

sameer: Implementation risks: profiling scale (we'll need batch runs across GPUs), and quality metric drift detection tuning. I suggest we prototype with 4 models first (small, med, large, LLaMA-variant) and iterate.

opt-bot: Added task T-4821 to product backlog: \"Optimize toolkit MVP - recommender + alerts (triage)\" <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/T-4821> :white_check_mark:

maya: Great. Action items:
- sameer: plan infra for profiling + token-cost calc (this sprint)
- kai: prototype quant/quality profiler + example outputs (this sprint)
- julia: recruit 2 pilot customers and draft evaluation contract (this sprint)
- maya: prepare launch checklist + docs skeleton (this sprint)

julia: One more ask — we should include recommended quantization caveats per workload (e.g., LLM generation vs. embeddings differ significantly). I'll draft a short appendix.

sameer: Noted. Will surface per-model memory vs KV cache tradeoffs in the doc.

maya: OK team — let's sync after spike ends (Friday). If anybody wants to push scope, ping me with tradeoffs and estimated engineer-weeks. :thumbsup:
